extracted.name: Easy Chicken and Dumplings
extracted.description: Reminds me of my Grandmere. Easy to make and reheats great.
ingredient_lines: 1 package Mary B open kettle dumplings
1 tablespoon Moutard de Beaune Dijon mustard
680 g (1.5 pounds) Boneless skinless chicken thighs, cut into bite-sized pieces
as needed (for garnish) Fresh chopped parsley
instruction_lines: Heat olive oil in a large pot over medium heat. Sauté celery, carrots, and onion for 3 minutes.
Add garlic and cook for 30 seconds. Stir in Dijon mustard.
Add butter and flour, whisk for 1 minute.
Gradually add chicken broth and bouillon, scraping the pot. Add thyme, sage, rosemary, salt, and pepper.
Add chicken pieces, bring to a boil. Cover, reduce heat, and simmer 10 minutes until chicken is cooked.
Stir in evaporated milk and frozen peas.
Drop in dumplings one by one. If stuck together, microwave dumplings for 30 seconds.
Simmer for 20–30 minutes. Taste and adjust salt and pepper.
Serve warm, garnished with fresh parsley.
